skill.summary: 面向内容运营、品牌调研和创作者的小红书内容研究辅助技能。适用于 RedNote / XHS / Xiaohongshu（小红书）内容研究、选题分析、关键词观察、趋势判断、竞品内容对比和素材整理。

security_audit.summary: Markdown formatting, vendor links, and readable multilingual text account for most static alerts. The documented CLI runs an unpinned package with access to credentials, and the output rules require retaining token-bearing links even when forwarding results. No evidence of embedded secrets, encoded payloads, or attempts to manipulate this audit was found.

remediation.issue: Unpinned CLI execution with access to SocialDataX credentials
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version in examples and installer metadata. Separate installation from credential access, require explicit install approval, and use a scoped key in an isolated runtime.

remediation.issue: User keywords placed into a shell command template
remediation.suggestion: Pass keywords and pagination cursors as separate arguments through a process API without a shell, or use structured MCP parameters. Do not construct shell commands from research input.

remediation.issue: CLI stores an API key in a local credentials file
remediation.suggestion: Prefer an OS credential store or a managed secret. If file storage is necessary, test restrictive permissions on each supported platform and document key removal and rotation.

remediation.issue: Token-bearing note links are retained in shared outputs
remediation.suggestion: Use note IDs or verified token-free links in shared reports. Keep complete links only where needed for authorized access, and redact query tokens from logs and exports.

content.value_statement: It takes time to find relevant Xiaohongshu posts and compare their content. This skill uses SocialDataX search samples to identify recurring topics, compare content angles, and suggest questions for further research.
actual_capabilities: Searches for Xiaohongshu notes by keyword through the SocialDataX CLI or MCP tool.
Filters notes by media type and publication window, and can sort by recency, likes, comments, or saves.
Extends a search with pagination and supports page and item limits in the CLI.
Organizes relevant samples by title, creator, and note reference when those fields are available.
Separates observations from interpretations when summarizing topics, creator positioning, or competitor content.
limitations: Live search requires configured SocialDataX authentication and network access. Search terms go to SocialDataX, and requests can consume credits.
Results cover only the pages and filters used. They do not represent all Xiaohongshu posts.
The search does not post, like, comment, or change Xiaohongshu accounts.
The documented CLI uses an unpinned npm package. Returned note links may contain query tokens that should not appear in shared reports.

use_cases.title: Choose topics for a content calendar
use_cases.description: Review a small set of notes in your niche and identify angles worth testing in your next posts.

use_cases.title: Compare competitor positioning
use_cases.description: Compare how two brands frame a shared topic using matching search filters and sample sizes.

use_cases.title: Check emerging audience questions
use_cases.description: Review recent posts for repeated questions and distinguish observations from ideas that need more evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Find a first sample
prompt_templates.prompt: Using the verified SocialDataX connection already configured, search one page for [keyword]. List relevant titles and note IDs, then suggest two follow-up questions.

prompt_templates.title: Review recent posts
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: a time and media filter
prompt_templates.prompt: Using the existing verified connection, review recent video notes for [topic]. Limit the search to one page and report the publication window and recurring themes.

prompt_templates.title: Compare two brand searches
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [brand A] and [brand B] for [topic] using the existing verified connection and the same publication window. Use one page per brand and separate observed differences from possible explanations.

prompt_templates.title: Test whether a theme repeats
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: bounded pagination and evidence quality
prompt_templates.prompt: Using the existing verified connection, test whether [theme] recurs for [keyword]. Ask before extending beyond one page, mark partial results, and cite note IDs. Explain what the sample cannot establish.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Review one page of recent video notes on desk organization.
output: Scope: One page of video results from the past week.
Observation: Several notes show cable storage and before-and-after desk layouts.
Interpretation: A short desk reset may be worth testing as a content topic. The sample does not establish platform-wide demand.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Compare how two brands discuss refillable bottles.
output: Scope: One page per brand with the same publication window.
Observation: Brand A samples emphasize cleaning. Brand B samples emphasize portability.
Next step: Check whether these differences persist across a larger matched sample before drawing conclusions about either brand.

best_practices: Start with one page, record the filters used, and expand only when the research question needs more evidence.
Use an approved connection and keep API keys out of chats, project files, and reports.
Cite note IDs or verified token-free links in shared reports and label partial results.
anti_patterns: Treating a few returned pages as a platform-wide trend.
Running the unpinned CLI in a credentialed environment without reviewing and approving the package.
Forwarding token-bearing links or credential details in public reports.

faq.question: What do Xiaohongshu, XHS, and RedNote refer to?
faq.answer: They refer to the same platform in this skill. It uses SocialDataX to search for Xiaohongshu notes.

faq.question: Do I need an API key?
faq.answer: The CLI needs a SocialDataX key. An existing authenticated MCP connection can use its own credentials without local CLI setup.

faq.question: Can I focus on recent video posts?
faq.answer: Yes. Select video as the note type and specify a supported publication window.

faq.question: Does the skill post or interact with accounts?
faq.answer: No. It searches and summarizes notes. It does not post, like, comment, or modify Xiaohongshu accounts.

faq.question: What happens if credits run out?
faq.answer: The search may stop with partial results. Check the provider account before authorizing more requests.

faq.question: Can I share note references in a report?
faq.answer: Use note IDs or verified token-free links. Keep full token-bearing links out of shared reports.
